newsitem.title: SPAIN: Latam is top destination for Spanish investment.
newsitem.headline: Latam is top destination for Spanish investment.

text.p: Latin America has become the premier destination for Spanish investment abroad and smaller businesses should be encouraged to invest as well, Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday.

Up to now, major investments had been made by multinationals and other large corporations, and Spain wants to encourage investments by small- and medium-sized companies, Rato said in an address at the annual general meeting of the Inter-American Development Bank (IADB).
"It is our desire that small- and medium-companies acquire a greater role as investors in Latin America and in the Caribbean which will support," Rato said.

According to IADB statistics, Spain was Europe's largest direct investor in Latin America between 1990 and 1994, and the second largest globally after the U.S., with an average annual investment of $531 million.
